title: Late Request Handling
description: What a seller does with a request that arrives after a booking round's request_deadline. Consumers MUST tolerate values added in later minors.

enumDescriptions.accepted: Accepted with the same placement guarantee as an on-time request. Any late_request_pricing_option_id still selects the price.
enumDescriptions.accepted_without_guarantee: Accepted, but the seller does not guarantee placement or positioning. The downgrade MUST be visible to the buyer before commitment.
enumDescriptions.rejected: Not accepted for this round. The seller returns a terminal error, not a submitted task.
